claims.text: The Harbor Street Bridge passed its latest inspection with no structural defects.
Repairing the Harbor Street Bridge will cost about 800,000 dollars.
Inspectors rated the pier 4 bearing of the Harbor Street Bridge as poor.
The Harbor Street Bridge carries about 9,000 vehicles a day.

draft.sentence: The city's own March inspection rated the pier 4 bearing "Condition rating: POOR (4 of 9)."
The same report put the fix at "Repair estimate: 2.4 million dollars."
An earlier draft line, kept here to show the check failing: "Condition rating: POOR (3 of 9)."
